name: Pull-up
summary: Hang from a bar with palms away, pull until the chin passes it, lower to straight arms.
setup: Hang from the bar, hands just wider than the shoulders, palms away, facing the phone. Pull the elbows down to bring the chin over the bar, then lower fully.
brief: Hang from the bar, hands just wider than the shoulders, palms away. Pull the elbows down to bring the chin over the bar, then lower fully.
why: Facing the phone the elbow angle closes and opens each rep, so reps are counted. Kipping and the chin actually clearing the bar are not judged.

faults.label: Not reaching the target
faults.tip: Take each rep through the full range you set — half reps count as partials.

faults.label: Too fast
faults.tip: Control both directions; momentum takes the work away from the muscle.

faults.label: Swinging or kicking
faults.tip: Legs quiet, no swing; if you need momentum, use a band.

faults.label: Not reaching full hang
faults.tip: The full hang at the bottom is the part that builds the shoulder.

faults.label: Not lowering fully
faults.tip: Each rep starts from a full hang.

faults.label: Shoulders at the ears
faults.tip: Set the shoulder blades down first, then pull.

guide.surface: A bar rated for body weight.

points.t: Straight at the bottom; elbows drive down to the ribs.
